events.verdict: Clowney (BKN) does not establish a legal guarding position in Wagner's (ORL) path prior to the contact on his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) fails to maintain his defensive path and delivers contact into Claxton's (BKN) body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Williams (BKN) directly contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Wagner's (ORL) hand after the release.

Wagner (ORL) immediately slides his hand off of Porter Jr.'s (BKN) side as he moves though the lane on the post feed. Porter's own hand is grabbing Wagner's jersey, impacting his ability to corral the entry pass.
da Silva (ORL) and Williams (BKN) briefly engage and disengage as they navigate the screen, and the contact is marginal.
Mann (BKN) briefly slides his hand across Carter's (ORL) back while he rolls to the basket.
Claxton (BKN) directly contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Wagner's (ORL) hand after the release.
Claxton (BKN) is firming up when he makes marginal contact with Suggs' (ORL) during the screen.
Carter Jr. (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Porter Jr. (BKN) extends his hands into Suggs' (ORL) body and initiates contact that affects his ability to defend the pick.
Claxton (BKN) is imminently exiting the lane within three seconds.
Mann (BKN) commits a take foul on Bane (ORL).

Isaac (ORL) contests the shot attempt and makes incidental contact with Mann's (BKN) leg on the follow through. Isaac would have avoided the leg contact had Mann not extended his leg outside his frame.
